units.passage: Familiarize yourself with University policies and guidelines on the use of Generative AI.
units.why: Tells faculty to "Familiarize yourself with University policies and guidelines on the use of Generative AI" and points to the AI Hub; keeping informed on AI guidance is P102.

units.passage: As we continue to witness the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and its potential impact on various domains, it is crucial for us as educators to stay informed and prepared for the evolving landscape of teaching and assessing student learning.
units.why: 'It is crucial for us as educators to stay informed and prepared' urges faculty to keep up with AI, so P102.

units.passage: University members should stay aware of and comply with any federal or state regulations governing AI use and data privacy.
units.why: Users of AI should 'stay aware of and comply with any federal or state regulations governing AI use and data privacy', which asks users to keep up with legal changes (P102) and comply with law.
units.fit_note: Combines staying informed with complying with law (P77).

units.passage: While Generative AI tools can be quite useful for personalizing learning experiences and rethinking teaching and instruction, both students and instructors should carefully consider the limitations and emerging best practices for using these tools.
units.why: "both students and instructors should carefully consider the limitations and emerging best practices" asks all users to stay informed; P102.

units.passage: Adaptation and continuous learning: Staying informed about AI advancements and developing skills to adapt to evolving AI technologies.
units.why: 'Adaptation and continuous learning: Staying informed about AI advancements' is a listed aspect of literacy that asks users to keep up with AI developments, so P102.

units.passage: GAI is a very rapidly evolving technology that is in a major state of flux. While companies are swiftly working to identify and fix issues as they are discovered, it is important for instructors to be aware of the risks involved in using GAI as is currently available.
units.why: Instructors should be 'aware of the risks' of current GAI in a technology 'in a major state of flux', a duty to stay informed: P102.

units.passage: Instructors should make themselves aware of the capabilities of current systems and the fast changing behavior of these systems on mathematical and engineering problems.
units.why: The report says 'Instructors should make themselves aware of the capabilities of current systems'. Faculty are told to stay informed, so P102.

units.passage: SOURCE: https://mtei.engineering.cornell.edu/genai-guidance-suggestions GenAI Guidance Suggestions – McCormick Teaching Excellence Institute Skip to main content Search: Submit Search Search Filters Search This Site Search Cornell McCormick Teaching Excellence Institute Main Menu Toggle Search Form Home Tips & Updates Classrooms Classroom Support (IT, A/V, Facilities) Classroom Descriptions Classroom Scheduling Classroom Equipment Computer Labs Course Evaluations Contact Home GenAI Guidance Suggestions Faculty Should be GenAI literate It is important for faculty to be GenAI literate.
units.why: The page says 'It is important for faculty to be GenAI literate.' Faculty should keep informed, so P102.

units.passage: Faculty can get a sense of GenAI capabilities by having it complete several homework or exam problems from your class.
units.why: The page suggests having 'it complete several homework or exam problems from your class' to learn GenAI capabilities. Faculty stay informed, so P102.
units.fit_note: Testing AI against own assessments to inform design rather than producing course content.

units.passage: Guidelines about these practices may change over time, so students should be sure to ask for the most up-to-date guidelines.
units.why: III.H warns "Guidelines about these practices may change over time, so students should be sure to ask for the most up-to-date guidelines"; it asks students to keep current with changing guidance (P102) rather than describing a review cycle (P54). The policy is also acknowledged as provisional.
units.fit_note: Also acknowledges that AI guidelines change over time (P54) but does not commit to a review cycle. A coded this unit as informs, P54, and noted that the sentence also tells students to ask for the latest guidelines.

units.passage: In addition to reviewing the Directive for Appropriate Use of Generative AI Tools and Services, the University recommends reviewing the Guiding Considerations for Integrating AI within Teaching and Learning .
units.why: "In addition to reviewing the Directive ..., the University recommends reviewing the Guiding Considerations for Integrating AI within Teaching and Learning" tells readers to keep up with current University guidance, so P102 (stay informed about guidance) with should. It follows a sentence addressed to all users, so the actor is all and the phase general.
units.fit_note: Recommends reviewing a named guidance document; it does not describe a duty to follow developments in general.

units.passage: Generative AI technology companies typically provide usage policies to promote safe and responsible use of their products (e.g. Terms of Service for Copilot) Users should be aware of such guidelines set forth by external entities, including the vendor, to ensure ethical and lawful use of the technology. These policies are frequently updated without notice and should be reviewed regularly.
units.why: Users should be aware of vendor usage policies that "are frequently updated without notice and should be reviewed regularly". P102 (stay informed) fits best; P52 (terms of use) is about ownership of outputs, which is not the point here.
units.fit_note: Duty is to follow vendors' policies, not the institution's guidance. Concerns vendor terms of service and lawful use, not general AI developments.

units.passage: You must strive to stay updated with AI advancements and educational resources that can aid in better understanding and usage of these technologies.
units.why: 'you must strive to stay updated with AI advancements and educational resources' is a duty to keep up with AI developments (P102).

units.passage: An inquiry mindset will foster a culture of continuous learning about AI.
units.why: The principle that "an inquiry mindset will foster a culture of continuous learning about AI" encourages users to keep learning about AI, so P102 rather than P56.
units.fit_note: Framed as a principle, not a stated duty. / Framed as a cultural principle ('inquiry mindset') rather than a duty to follow guidance.

units.passage: Please read these in their entirety.
units.why: Directs readers to read the linked principles, awareness, guidance and data-classification pages in full; nearest type is P102 (keep up with institutional guidance), but it is a read-the-guidance duty, hence fit note. Chose P102 over P78 because P78 is about each course's rules.
units.fit_note: A request to read the linked institutional guidance, not to keep up with AI developments. / Also delegates the actual student and instructor rules to the System documents.

units.passage: As Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI’s GPT-4 become more prevalent in our daily lives and work, it is essential that we are well informed of their benefits and risks, and that we encourage their responsible use in our academic community.
units.why: Says it is 'essential' that the community is informed about LLM benefits and risks, which is a duty to stay informed (P102), should.

units.passage: We encourage you to read these documents in their entirety
units.why: Encourages faculty to read the principles and guidance pages ('read these documents in their entirety'); like the IT statement it is a read-the-guidance request, so P102 with a fit note.
units.fit_note: A request to read institutional guidance, not to follow AI developments.

units.passage: AI is a rapidly developing technology. You should regularly check on university, collegiate, and instructor guidance to keep up with changes.
units.why: "regularly check on university, collegiate, and instructor guidance to keep up with changes" asks users to stay current, P102.

units.passage: All users are responsible for understanding how these tools work and for following the guidance below.
units.why: Makes "all users" "responsible for understanding how these tools work"; nearest to a duty to stay informed, P102.
units.fit_note: Asks users to understand how tools work and follow the guidance; does not mention following AI developments.

units.passage: Instructors should educate themselves on the permissible uses and disclosures of identifiable patient and plan member information to ensure any use or disclosure of such information in the context of generative AI does not run afoul of HIPAA or UMB policies.
units.why: Instructors "should educate themselves on the permissible uses and disclosures" of patient information. Stay informed, P102.
units.fit_note: Specific to HIPAA knowledge when teaching healthcare education.

units.passage: Review the Full Guidelines
units.policy: Instructors review the full guidelines document.
units.why: The action item "Review the Full Guidelines" asks instructors to read the guidelines document; P102 (stay informed) is nearest but it concerns the guidance itself rather than AI developments.
units.fit_note: Asks for review of the guidelines document itself, not of AI developments generally.

units.passage: The University expects members of its Workforce and student body who use GenAI technologies to educate themselves about these concerns, to use GenAI ethically and compliantly, and to take responsibility for managing risks appropriately.
units.why: The University "expects members of its Workforce and student body ... to educate themselves about these concerns", a duty to stay informed (P102).

units.passage: Users must take care to check for the latest University policy, and state and national regulatory and legal information before beginning new GenAI projects.
units.why: Users "must take care to check for the latest University policy" before new projects, a duty to keep up with guidance (P102).

units.passage: Familiarize yourself with the ethical implications of using AI in your role and apply best practices.
units.policy: Familiarize yourself with the ethical implications of using AI in your role and apply best practices.
units.why: 'Familiarize yourself with the ethical implications' asks users to keep informed, P102.
units.fit_note: Focuses on ethics and best practices rather than on developments or current guidance.

units.passage: Recognize the rapid evolution of the AI tools and embrace a mindset of continuous learning.
units.why: 'rapid evolution of the AI tools ... continuous learning' is a stay-informed rule, P102.

units.passage: Always consult CTL guidelines for most current AI use.
units.why: Page header says 'Always consult CTL guidelines for most current AI use.'; points to current guidance, P102.

units.passage: Norms and requirements surrounding the use of AI in coursework are complex and rapidly evolving, which requires students who use AI to take responsibility for keeping themselves informed about relevant developments.
units.policy: Students who use AI take responsibility for keeping themselves informed about relevant developments in norms and requirements for AI in coursework.
units.why: Students who use AI must 'take responsibility for keeping themselves informed about relevant developments': a duty to stay informed, P102.

units.passage: Just as these technologies are rapidly changing, you should anticipate that the citation guidance above may change. Be sure to check back regularly for any updates.
units.policy: You should anticipate that the citation guidance may change and check back regularly for any updates.
units.why: 'you should anticipate that the citation guidance above may change. Be sure to check back regularly' tells readers to keep up with updated guidance (P102).

units.passage: deberán adquirir, discutir y estudiar
units.policy: The relevant institutional bodies must obtain, discuss and study the periodic reports issued by the US National AI Advisory Committee or any other official body.
units.why: The bodies "deberán adquirir, discutir y estudiar los informes periódicos" of the US National AI Advisory Committee, a duty to stay informed, P102.

units.passage: In the meantime, please review the revised policy, update your course materials as needed, and contact SCED with questions about reporting or the new procedures.
units.why: 'please review the revised policy, update your course materials as needed' tells faculty to keep up with the policy and adjust materials (P102).

units.passage: Because these Guidelines may be updated from time to time, SCU community members are encouraged to regularly review the most recent version of these Guidelines which will be posted at Santa Clara University's AI Resources website.
units.why: Community members 'are encouraged to regularly review the most recent version'; a duty/encouragement to stay current with guidance, P102.

units.passage: We strongly encourage faculty members to learn about the limitations of AI-detecting software .
units.why: 'We strongly encourage faculty members to learn about the limitations of AI-detecting software' tells faculty to stay informed about a specific AI issue, P102.
units.fit_note: Learning is about limits of detectors rather than AI tools in general.

units.passage: By continuing to develop their own understanding of AI, faculty can better adapt their teaching and support their students.
units.why: Principle 7 says "By continuing to develop their own understanding of AI, faculty can better adapt their teaching", a call for faculty to keep learning, P102 (stay informed), not P63 which is the institution's support.

units.passage: Faculty should also explore opportunities for engagement through their professional associations as the possibilities, value, and implications of AI use vary across disciplines.
units.why: Faculty "should also explore opportunities for engagement through their professional associations"; a call to follow AI developments in their discipline, P102.

units.passage: Users of genAI should proactively stay informed about the policies, guidelines, and ethical considerations relevant to their field or specialty, including those established by professional organizations and through journals and publications.
units.why: "should proactively stay informed about the policies, guidelines" asks users to keep up with field-specific guidance, matching P102 (stay informed).

units.passage: Users of genAI should proactively stay informed about the policies, guidelines, and ethical considerations relevant to their field or specialty, including those established by professional organizations and through journals and publications.
units.why: "should proactively stay informed about the policies, guidelines" asks users to keep up with field-specific guidance, matching P102 (stay informed).

units.passage: Educate Yourself on the Potential Harms of AI Requirements or Bans
units.policy: Instructors are advised to educate themselves on the potential harms of AI requirements or bans.
units.why: "Educate Yourself on the Potential Harms of AI Requirements or Bans" asks instructors to learn before requiring or banning AI. P102 (stay informed) fits; P63 is institutional support, not a duty to self-educate.
units.fit_note: Asks for learning about harms of requirements or bans specifically.

units.passage: Stevens Generative AI Overview contains several additional resources regarding AI
units.why: 'Stevens Generative AI Overview contains several additional resources regarding AI' points users to further guidance, so P102 (informs).
units.fit_note: Points to resources; does not impose a duty to stay informed.

units.passage: Stay informed about evolving AI technologies, best practices, and ethical considerations to ensure responsible and effective use.
units.why: "Stay informed about evolving AI technologies, best practices, and ethical considerations" is a duty to keep current: P102.

units.passage: Stay informed. Follow conversations around AI technology and further updates and guidance from the university to incorporate the latest improvements and address any emerging risks as generative AI continues to develop.
units.why: "Stay informed. Follow conversations around AI technology and further updates and guidance from the university" is a duty to keep up with guidance: P102.

units.passage: Stay informed about the latest AI developments and best practices
units.why: "Stay informed about the latest AI developments and best practices"; P102.

units.passage: Engage in professional development opportunities to learn about new AI tools
units.why: "Stay informed about AI developments: Engage in professional development opportunities to learn about new AI tools"; faculty keep up, P102.

units.passage: Keep up-to-date with evolving AI technologies and ethics
units.why: "Keep up-to-date with evolving AI technologies and ethics. Participate in training sessions"; P102.

units.passage: However, it is important to follow guidance and familiarize yourself with UTA’s policies and resources before diving in head first.
units.policy: It is important to follow guidance and familiarize yourself with UTA’s policies and resources before using GenAI.
units.why: "it is important to follow guidance and familiarize yourself with UTA’s policies and resources before diving in head first" tells users to learn the current guidance before using GenAI; P102 fits better than P56 because it is a duty to know the guidance.

units.passage: Visit https://ai.uta.edu for campus‑wide AI initiatives, updates, and guidelines, and participate in future AI Course Redesign Institutes, CRTLE workshops, and Faculty Voices sessions.
units.why: The page tells faculty to visit ai.uta.edu for "updates, and guidelines" and join future sessions; staying informed, P102.

units.passage: We encourage all UTMB faculty and staff who use generative AI tools to continually check this website for the latest policy information and guidance.
units.why: Faculty and staff are urged to "continually check this website for the latest policy information and guidance", a duty to keep up with current guidance; P102 fits better than P54 because it binds users, not the policy.

units.passage: We encourage all users of generative AI tools to review the usage policies pertaining to all applicable generative AI models.
units.why: 'We encourage all users of generative AI tools to review the usage policies pertaining to all applicable generative AI models' asks users to read the vendors' rules, a duty to stay informed about guidance, so P102 with should and neutral.
units.fit_note: Concerns vendor usage policies for the AI models, not UTMB's own guidance; P102 fits partly.

units.passage: Students should use caution when using AI platforms and embrace a continuous learning mindset to make informed decisions.
units.why: "embrace a continuous learning mindset to make informed decisions" (with "Students should use caution when using AI platforms") asks students to stay informed about AI; P102 captures that, and the caution element is noted in fit_note.
units.fit_note: General caution and a learning mindset, not verification of output. / Also asks for caution with AI platforms, which P102 does not capture.

units.passage: We are hoping that you adopt a growth mindset around AI, continuously exploring new technologies and best practices on how to apply them.
units.why: Hopes students "adopt a growth mindset around AI, continuously exploring new technologies and best practices", staying informed, P102.

units.passage: This site has been established to share the latest advancements in AI advancements and implications for the university
units.why: The site is meant to keep the community informed about AI developments, which is P102 (stay informed) in spirit, though phrased as the university's service rather than a user duty.
units.fit_note: The university commits to publish updates; it does not tell users to stay informed. | The site offers information rather than imposing a duty to stay informed.

units.passage: Because apps and third-party platforms often update their features, it is important to have the most up-to-date understanding of those capabilities before course delivery in case your policy needs to be commensurately updated.
units.policy: Instructors have the most up-to-date understanding of apps' and third-party platforms' capabilities before course delivery, in case the policy needs to be commensurately updated.
units.why: Advises instructors to keep current on AI tools since 'apps and third-party platforms often update their features', which is staying informed (P102) so the policy can be updated.
units.fit_note: Also says the policy may need to be updated when platform features change.

units.passage: Because of the rapid development of AI technology and its many applications to different fields, we recommend faculty stay abreast of developments in their own field
units.why: 'We recommend faculty stay abreast of developments in their own field' is a duty to keep up with AI developments, which matches P102.

units.why: 'we recommend faculty stay abreast of developments in their own field' tells faculty to keep up with AI news: P102.

units.passage: check back as guidance evolves alongside the technology.
units.why: Tells users to "check back as guidance evolves", a duty to stay current: P102.

units.why: 'Faculty, staff, and students are encouraged to stay informed': a duty to keep up with AI developments, P102.

units.passage: Staying curious and informed helps us all engage with these tools in more meaningful and responsible ways.
units.why: 'Staying curious and informed helps us all engage with these tools in more meaningful and responsible ways' encourages users to keep up. P102 fits.

units.why: "Keep yourself informed regarding development of new AI resources, ethical considerations" is a duty to stay current, so P102.

units.why: 'Both W&M and GenAI users should keep abreast of the changing legal landscape' is a duty to stay informed (P102); all, over-time, should.

units.why: 'GenAI users should remain apprised of current developments in GenAI copyright law' asks users to keep up with legal developments, P102.

units.why: Administrators of GenAI tools "should keep up to date on relevant changes to laws, regulations and policies", a duty to stay informed, so P102.
